stories.title: Consent Tier Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement core business logic in ConsentService to enforce two-tier consent rules, including routing of data to de-identified vs identifiable storage paths, validation of consent state transitions, and invocation of HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification where required.

stories.title: Consent API & Cross-Service Integration
stories.description: Expose consent framework through application layer and integrate with dependent services (lead_capture, unknown_question_service, debug_logger) to ensure all persisted data flows respect consent tier decisions.
